subject: Help with mysterious segfault on fn=50

messages.author: 8c6b85a01a12e3e2
messages.subject: Help with mysterious segfault on fn=50
parts:
Hi all,

I've got a mysterious segfault I can't diagnose.  The model runs fine on most of my datasets, and fails reliably at fn=50 for a specific one. The datasets are generated by automated sql queries and so the same process is used for all, and I'm unable to find any structural differences in the datasets that work from the one that doesn't. Unfortunately, I'm not able to share the data for a reproducible example (sorry!), but I've copied the verbose output below to see if it says something useful to one of you.

Any thoughts? And thanks!

--Mike


family <- rep('poisson',8)

formula ~ cbind(outcome.1, outcome.2, outcome.3, outcome.4, outcome.5, outcome.6, outcome.7, outcome.8) ~
